AI TECHNOLOGY

Data, method, evidence and review.

Video is a continuous workload. The system checks frames for defined events, groups repeated detections and sends only the relevant time window for a supervisor to review.

01 / PLANNED MODEL PATH

Defined-event vision detection

Detect the selected gate state or movement event in sampled frames without recognizing identity.

How to evaluate it +

Use authorized labelled clips and evaluate false/missed events by site condition.

02 / PLANNED MODEL PATH

Temporal event grouping

Combine repeated frame observations into one bounded review window.

How to evaluate it +

Measure repeated alerts, incorrectly merged events and clip boundaries.

03 / PLANNED MODEL PATH

Supervisor brief generation

Explain the event rule, time window and evidence reference.

How to evaluate it +

Check timestamps, source references, uncertainty and absence of unsupported identity claims.

COMPUTE CHOICE

Sampled video is the clearest GPU-inference candidate in this collection. Capacity depends on streams × sampled frames per second × model latency. Compare an Azure ML online endpoint with an AKS GPU serving pool, measure both and group events before asking a language model for a brief.

Architecture and evaluation plan. The candidate sector models require implementation and validation.

Infrastructure for security workloads.

A product-level operating plan, with a job for each service and clear implementation boundaries.

PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Static Web Apps

Serve the product interface through managed HTTPS and a CDN when the Azure deployment is configured. The current public release is hosted on GitHub Pages.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Microsoft Entra ID

Use organization membership and reviewer/operator roles. Production identity and tenant authorization are planned; public sample access is not an Entra account.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Blob Storage

Keep source versions under tenant-scoped access, with encryption and retention rules configured for the actual data. Storage isolation must be implemented and tested.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Key Vault + managed identity

Keep provider credentials on the server. Move deployment secrets into Key Vault and use managed workload identity where supported.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Service Bus + Azure ML

Queue new inputs, cache unchanged evidence and handle failed jobs. Select CPU, managed inference or evaluated GPU serving according to the product’s model path.

AKS GPU serving is an alternative to evaluate if self-hosted inference is justified.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Private Link

Use private service endpoints for supported internal data paths when the deployment’s network design requires them. No private network deployment is claimed by this static release.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.
PRODUCTION INTEGRATION PLAN

Azure Monitor, Application Insights + Defender for Cloud

Track processing failures, access events and resource health. Set retention, alert ownership and security posture checks before production use.

Platform services require deployment configuration and validation.

Service names are not an uptime, certification or consumption claim. The roadmap identifies the current connector and integration state.

HOW THE JOB GETS DONE

Four steps.
One useful decision.

No face identification or automatic emergency dispatch. A supervisor verifies every event and follows the site’s response procedure.

  1. 01

    Set the site rules

    Choose the cameras, operating hours and events the site is authorized to monitor.

  2. 02

    Check the footage

    Look for the defined event and group repeated detections.

  3. 03

    Show the relevant clip

    Attach the camera reference, time window and reason for review.

  4. 04

    Verify and respond

    A supervisor checks the video and records the response.

WHY THIS NEEDS SUBSTANTIAL AI PROCESSING

Real work creates
a recurring workload.

Video is a continuous workload. The system checks frames for defined events, groups repeated detections and sends only the relevant time window for a supervisor to review.

Planning scenario · not current customer usageRepeated checks while the site is monitored
57,024,000frame checks / month
9,504,000stream-minute windows in this scenario
6sampled frames per minute
55 organizations×8 camera streams per operator×21,600 monitored minutes / stream / month×6 sampled frames per minute

The scenario assumes 12 hours per day for 30 days. Sampling six frames per minute produces a large recurring computer-vision workload; full clips are escalated only for defined events.

Estimated monthly volume57,024,000 frame checksVolume estimate only. Model cost and runtime depend on the chosen service and input size.

These are explicit assumptions for evaluating the product idea. Actual usage, model billing and performance need measurement. Unchanged inputs should be cached rather than processed again.

REVIEW WORKSPACE

Evidence-led processing.
An accountable reviewer.

The public review desk includes source-linked prepared cases. The server adapter supports connected analysis with your configured model service.

01

Available in the website

Choose two cases, run the prepared analysis, inspect cited evidence, accept a report for review and download it. The dashboard also supports operational notes, status changes, search, filtering and CSV export.

02

Connected AI analysis

The included Node server calls an AI provider with your text and optional images. It asks for a structured report with source references. Configure the API key on the server; no key is embedded in this public website.

03

Repeated processing

The adapter caches identical input for a limited period. New or changed evidence produces a new analysis. Published workload totals are planning arithmetic, not actual customer traffic.

04

Human judgment

No face identification or automatic emergency dispatch. A supervisor verifies every event and follows the site’s response procedure.

05

Before operating commercially

Connect the real source systems, implement verified accounts and organization access, evaluate the model on representative inputs and define how operators handle uncertain results.
